intro: The English Football League (EFL) returns this weekend with an array of compelling fixtures across the Championship, League One, and League Two. According to BBC Sport, five major talking points are set to dominate the agenda, from surprise league leaders to teams mounting impressive comebacks. This weekend promises to offer plenty of drama and intrigue as clubs battle for promotion, playoff spots, and survival.

sections.heading: Surprise Leaders Shaping the Season
sections.text: One of the most captivating narratives heading into the weekend is the emergence of unexpected pacesetters in various divisions. While traditional powerhouses often dominate the headlines, the presence of underdog teams at the top of the tables adds a refreshing twist to this season's storyline. This unpredictability is part of what makes the EFL competitions so fiercely competitive and beloved by fans. Whether these teams can maintain their momentum as the season progresses remains to be seen, but every match is now under heightened scrutiny.

sections.heading: Teams on Resurgent Runs
sections.text: Another major point of interest highlighted by BBC Sport is the resurgence of certain clubs after lackluster starts. A string of positive results can quickly turn a season around in the EFL, where fixture congestion and squad depth often play critical roles in determining outcomes. Clubs that seemed destined for mid-table obscurity or relegation battles may now find themselves eyeing a climb up the standings. This weekend’s matches could serve as another litmus test for how far these teams have come and whether their form is sustainable over the long haul.

analysis: The unpredictability of the EFL remains one of its defining characteristics, making it a compelling watch for neutrals and die-hard supporters alike. The rise of unexpected league leaders is a testament to the league's egalitarian nature, where financial disparities are often less pronounced than in higher tiers like the Premier League. Meanwhile, the resurgence of struggling teams underscores how quickly fortunes can change with good management, tactical adjustments, and team cohesion. Analysts will likely view this weekend’s action as pivotal for many teams looking to solidify newfound form or stay atop their respective divisions.

faq.question: What is the EFL?
faq.answer: The English Football League (EFL) is a collection of three professional football divisions below the Premier League: the Championship, League One, and League Two. It is one of the most competitive football pyramids in the world.

faq.question: Why are surprise leaders notable in the EFL?
faq.answer: Surprise leaders are notable as they disrupt expectations and highlight the unpredictable nature of the league, where smaller or unfancied clubs can challenge traditional giants over the course of the season.

faq.question: What do resurgent runs indicate in football?
faq.answer: Resurgent runs often indicate improved tactics, player form, and morale within a team. They can turn a disappointing season into a successful one, particularly in leagues as tightly contested as the EFL.

conclusion: With surprise leaders and resurgent teams in the mix, this weekend’s EFL fixtures are set to deliver more twists to an already unpredictable season. Football fans will undoubtedly be on the edge of their seats as the action unfolds across the Championship, League One, and League Two.
